item.title: SU/UNC is on NewsChannel 9 Saturday at 1 pm
item.description: SYRACUSE, N.Y. (WSYR-TV) -- The Syracuse University men's basketball team returns to the JMA Wireless Dome Saturday as they take on the North Carolina Tar Heels. Tip time is 1 p.m. The game can be seen on television on NewsChannel 9. The game can also be heard on the radio on TK 99 FM.
